_readme: Non-residential offers. 'contract' prices are 12-month contracts billed monthly (not prepaid). Pending records render only in review builds.

agentMonthly.name: Video Starter
scope: Up to 3 agent-on-camera social videos (30–45 sec)
2 filming hours, about 60 minutes of raw footage

agentMonthly.name: Video Accelerator
scope: 2 hours on site + 1 hour in studio, about 90 minutes of raw footage
Dedicated content strategist and a monthly strategy meeting

agentMonthly.name: Video Pro
scope: 2 hours on site + 2 hours in studio, about 120 minutes of raw footage
Prioritized content strategist and a monthly strategy meeting

businessMonthly.name: Video Accelerator
scope: 2 hours on site + 1 hour in studio
Content strategist and monthly strategy meeting

businessMonthly.name: Video Pro + Management
scope: 2 hours on site + 2 hours in studio
Prioritized strategist and monthly strategy meeting

creatorSessions.name: Single studio session
creatorSessions.detail: Up to 90 minutes of recording time.
includes: Live-cut file (raw files), video and audio
creatorSessions.note: James, Sep 27 2026 (answering Codex S15-16): the single 90-minute session is $249, matching licreatorstudios.com/pricing. The public Square listing shows 'Price Varies'; the site makes no claim that Square checkout shows this figure. Source: Long Island Creator Studios pricing page (licreatorstudios.com/pricing).

creatorSessions.name: General studio content
creatorSessions.detail: Film anything you like in the studio: short-form content, educational videos, photoshoots and more.
includes: Full studio access and custom setups

creatorSessions.name: Recording + editing
creatorSessions.detail: Two 90-minute sessions a month, edited and ready to post.
creatorSessions.extra: Optional start-up package: an in-studio photoshoot, an announcement video and social post, a custom podcast intro and outro, and a one-on-one coaching and strategy meeting.
